# Central Seattle Dispatch

> The Central Seattle Dispatch is a free weekly email newsletter about Seattle, WA, sent Thursdays at 6 AM Pacific and published by Neighborhood Press LLC. It covers city council decisions, land-use and permit notices, road and transit changes, school district news, openings and closings, with one section per neighborhood. Every item links its public source. It is researched and written with AI tools, and an editor reads every issue before it goes out.

## Key pages
- [This week in Central Seattle](https://www.centralseattledispatch.com/this-week/): the dated items for the current week, updated every Thursday
- [Central Seattle news](https://www.centralseattledispatch.com/news/): every story, newest first
- [Reader asked](https://www.centralseattledispatch.com/asked/): readers' questions answered from the public record
- [Standards](https://www.centralseattledispatch.com/standards/): publisher, sources, sponsors, corrections
- [Subscribe](https://www.centralseattledispatch.com/): free, one email a week

## Neighborhoods
- [Capitol Hill](https://www.centralseattledispatch.com/capitol-hill/): Broadway, Cal Anderson Park, Volunteer Park and the Capitol Hill light rail station, from Pike/Pine to the north end of the hill.
- [Eastlake](https://www.centralseattledispatch.com/eastlake/): The strip between Lake Union and I-5 along Eastlake Avenue East, with the houseboat docks and the University Bridge at the north end.
- [Montlake](https://www.centralseattledispatch.com/montlake/): Between Portage Bay and Union Bay, with the Montlake Cut, the Montlake Bridge, Montlake Playfield and the SR 520 interchange work.
- [Madison Park](https://www.centralseattledispatch.com/madison-park/): The lakefront at the end of East Madison Street: Madison Park Beach, the shops on 42nd Avenue East and Broadmoor.
- [Washington Park](https://www.centralseattledispatch.com/washington-park/): The streets along the Washington Park Arboretum and Lake Washington Boulevard East, between Montlake and Madison Park.
- [Harrison / Denny-Blaine](https://www.centralseattledispatch.com/harrison-denny-blaine/): The Madison Valley shops on East Madison Street, Denny-Blaine Park on the lake and the Lake Washington Boulevard curve between Madrona and Madison Park.
- [Madrona](https://www.centralseattledispatch.com/madrona/): The hill above Lake Washington around 34th Avenue, with Madrona Park beach and the shops at 34th and Union.
- [Leschi](https://www.centralseattledispatch.com/leschi/): The lakefront and hillside south of Madrona, with Leschi Park, the marina, Frink Park and the Lake Washington Boulevard bend.
- [Central District](https://www.centralseattledispatch.com/central-district/): Along 23rd Avenue from Jackson Street to Union Street, with Garfield Community Center, Powell Barnett Park and the Cherry Street and Union Street corridors.
